notes: *so that* is one rendering of the waw under rule 55's coordinator-plus-subordinator sentence, headed on the coordinator; heading on *that* is named as the competing reading.
*could not* is written in two words, so rule 35 splits them: לֹא takes *not* and יָכֹל takes *they could*. No *cannot* fusion is available.
נֶפֶשׁ → *the dead body* heads on *body* under rule 31's tie-break, with *dead* named as the alternative; the supplied *the* joins the noun's unit under rule 15.
Both occurrences of לִפְנֵי fuse to a single *before* under rule 30, headed on the construct noun that carries the lexeme.
